AttemptRecord.description: One rung tried. `status` is None when no response arrived (network error, timeout, SSRF rejection).
AttemptRecord.title: AttemptRecord

ExportPage.description: One page of a job's records in an export format (SPEC-08 §4.11); `next_cursor` as in `RecordPage`.
ExportPage.title: ExportPage

ExtractedRecord.description:
A record's content (§6 `record`): `complete` when every required field and group published (§10), and its
confidence, the minimum over the required fields, `None` when any of them is uncalibrated. A replay answers with
these: they are not stored, so they have no id.
ExtractedRecord.title: ExtractedRecord

FetchSummary.description: The fetch of the page: the method, status and class of the kept attempt, and every attempt made.
FetchSummary.title: FetchSummary

FieldLabel.description:
One field's label. `absent` means the field is genuinely not on the page (G2); `distractors` are values of the
same field shown for another entity on the page, which drive the wrong-product metric (§16.3).
FieldLabel.title: FieldLabel

FieldSpec-Input.description:
One field of a schema, or the item of a list.

The parameters a type needs are present exactly for that type: `vocab` for `enum`, `scheme` for `identifier`,
`item` for `list`, `fields` for `object`.
FieldSpec-Input.title: FieldSpec

FieldSpec-Output.description:
One field of a schema, or the item of a list.

The parameters a type needs are present exactly for that type: `vocab` for `enum`, `scheme` for `identifier`,
`item` for `list`, `fields` for `object`.
FieldSpec-Output.title: FieldSpec

FieldType.description: The §5.1 field types. A type is added here only together with its normalizer module (C8).
FieldType.title: FieldType

OutcomeCounts.description: How many of the job's tasks ended with each outcome (`url_task.outcome`, ARCHITECTURE §6).
OutcomeCounts.title: OutcomeCounts

Problem.description:
RFC 9457 problem details (SPEC-07 §4.3). `type` is one of the API's problem types, or `about:blank` when the
HTTP status says all there is to say (RFC 9457 §4.2.1); `instance` is the request's path (§3.1.5).
Problem.title: Problem

RecordPage.description: One page of records, newest first; `next_cursor` is null on the last page.
RecordPage.title: RecordPage

SchemaContent.description: A schema document as a caller writes it, without the name and version the registry assigns.
SchemaContent.title: SchemaContent

SchemaDef.description:
A `schema_def` row (ARCHITECTURE §6): a document plus where it came from and whether it is in use. Rows are
immutable per (name, version); a change is a new version.
SchemaDef.title: SchemaDef

ScrapeRequest.description:
The body of `POST /v1/scrape` (§4.4). `records` needs a schema and a `page_kind`, and the schema's page kind
must be that one; listing records wait for SPEC-05 PR 12. A `schema.prompt` is drafted and returned, and
`budget.llm_calls` bounds its draft. `max_age` reuses a capture fetched within that many seconds.
ScrapeRequest.title: ScrapeRequest

ScrapeResult.description:
The answer to a scrape (§4.4). A page that robots.txt kept from being fetched has no capture, so
`capture_id`, `final_url`, `fetched_at` and `fetch` are None. `schema` is the draft of a `schema.prompt`.
ScrapeResult.title: ScrapeResult

ScrapedRecord.description: A stored record as `scrape` answers with it.
ScrapedRecord.title: ScrapedRecord

StoredRecord.description:
A `record` row, with the capture it was extracted from (`None` once the capture expired, ARCHITECTURE §15),
the schema version its fields follow, and its own version (§14).
StoredRecord.title: StoredRecord

TaskCounts.description: How many of the job's tasks are in each status (SPEC-01 §4.3).
TaskCounts.title: TaskCounts

post.description:
The records the current engine makes from the capture, against the schema versions of the records stored from
it. 404: no such capture, or its bundle expired; 409: no record was made from it.
`crawlerai eval capture` into dev (§4.4): fetch each URL and store it as an unlabeled dev page.

schema.title: Response List Pages V1 Eval Pages Get

ETag.description: Entity tag of the stored labels (RFC 9110 §8.8.3)

put.description:
Store one pass of labels (§16.2). `status` `draft` or `labeled` is the labeler's pass and clears any check;
`checked` is the checker's pass over a labeled page, by someone other than its labeler.

With `If-Match` set to the `ETag` of the page as read, a pass over labels that have changed since is refused
with 412 (RFC 9110 §13.1.1); a pass that races another store between this request's read and write is 409.

ETag.description: Entity tag of the stored labels (RFC 9110 §8.8.3)

post.description:
The field type's normalized value for `raw_text`, or its reason to decline. The normalizers arrive with
SPEC-04 PRs 2 to 8.

Store and return a `draft` that role C fills from the page's cleaned text (`crawlerai.eval.prefill`), with
`prefill_source=llm:<model>` and no labeler. It replaces a draft, never a labeled or checked page (409), and
`If-Match` works as for `PUT labels`. 503 or 502 when the model gives no valid reply; nothing is stored then.

ETag.description: Entity tag of the stored labels (RFC 9110 §8.8.3)

delete.description:
Cancel the job: its queued tasks are not run, and it is `cancelled` once no task is running. 409: it already
completed or failed.

get.description: The job's status, its task counts by status and by outcome, and its usage.

The job's records, newest first: in the field shape of `/v1/records` (`format=json`), or as `json_records`,
`csv_records` or `markdown` text in the schema's columns. Pass a page's `next_cursor` as `cursor` for the page
after it. 409: an export of a job without a schema.

schema.title: Response Job Results V1 Jobs  Job Id  Results Get

get.description:
Records newest first, narrowed by job, site (host) and schema version. Pass a page's `next_cursor` as `cursor`
for the page after it.
Every version of every schema; only those of `name` and in `status` when given.

delete.description: Retires this version. The row stays, since records and configs reference it; a preset is refused (409).

put.description:
Adds the next version with `body` as its whole document and returns it. `schema_id` must be the latest
version, active and not a preset; otherwise 409.

post.description:
Fetch `url`, or read a capture of it fetched within `max_age` seconds, and return the requested formats; only
those are members of the answer. A `schema.prompt` is drafted into a schema, returned as `schema`. `records`
holds the page's record against the schema; an inline schema is stored as a `user` schema, or matched to its
name's latest version, and one that differs from that version is a 409.
